description: The price of reading the business again from the web, before anything is spent: a fresh read of its site or channel address and its pages, the same careful read setup made, on the owner's tokens. price: measured, from what this business's last read cost (or, with none, the median read on Marsell), charged at what the read really uses, so say it as about that many tokens; null when nothing measured it, so say no price is known. waiting: a review of the business is already open or reading, so it cannot start; say where. Say the price to the owner and ask; start it with business_read_start only once they say yes, in their next message.

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.
